description: This file defines the LeaveParameterObject class, a Data Transfer Object (DTO) used for managing leave parameters such as employee number, leave type, date ranges, and duration details within the OrangeHRM leave plugin.

classes.name: LeaveParameterObject
classes.description: A DTO class encapsulating leave parameters such as employee ID, leave type, date range, comment, and duration options, with validation and helper methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes leave parameters with employee number, leave type, start and end dates.

methods.name: isMultiDayLeave
methods.description: Determines if the leave spans multiple days based on from and to dates.

methods.name: getEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number associated with the leave.

methods.name: setEmployeeNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the ID of the leave type.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type ID.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the leave.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the leave.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave, with validation to ensure it is after the start date.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Retrieves the optional comment for the leave.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets an optional comment for the leave.

methods.name: getSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Retrieves the duration object for a single-day leave; throws exception if called for multi-day leave.

methods.name: setSingleDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for a single-day leave.

methods.name: getStartMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Retrieves the start duration object for multi-day leave; includes validation.

methods.name: setStartMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the start duration for multi-day leave with validation.

methods.name: getEndMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Retrieves the end duration object for multi-day leave; includes validation.

methods.name: setEndMultiDayDuration
methods.description: Sets the end duration for multi-day leave with validation.

methods.name: getMultiDayPartialOption
methods.description: Returns the partial option for multi-day leave; throws exception if called for single day.

methods.name: setMultiDayPartialOption
methods.description: Sets the partial option for multi-day leave, validating allowed options.
